title: RFQ with cybersecurity / software requirement
document:
Request for Quote: Connected Gateway ECU
Customer: Nordwind Automotive
Program: NW-CX Connected Platform
RFQ ID: RFQ-2026-EE-330
Due Date: 2026-09-15
Target SOP: 2028-01-10
Region: Europe
Product: Connected vehicle gateway ECU
Estimated Annual Volume: 92000 units
Requested Price Target: 128.50 EUR per unit
Requirements:
- Provide UNECE R155/R156 cybersecurity and software update documentation
- Describe the over-the-air software update process and security documentation
- Provide a supplier constraint and semiconductor shortage risk assessment
- Submit response via the customer portal by due date

Notes:
Security documentation is mandatory for this connected program. There is a known semiconductor supply risk on the gateway SoC.
